name: io.github.luckmanqasim/sota-anchor
title: sota-anchor
description: Checks what already exists before your coding agent builds it from scratch.

environmentVariables.name: SOTA_ANCHOR_GITHUB_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Raises GitHub's search limit from 10 to 30 requests a minute. Any token works; it needs no scopes.

environmentVariables.name: SOTA_ANCHOR_BRAVE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Adds general web search through Brave Search as an evidence source.
